title: Regular trajectories, pruning and quantum parity

abstractEnglish: We prove that constant-depth quantum circuits with arbitrary one-qubit gates and unbounded-arity Toffoli gates cannot compute parity with any fixed positive worst-case advantage using polynomially many total qubits. Ancillary qubits are initialized to $`|0\rangle`$, one output qubit is measured, and all other final registers may be discarded without restriction. This resolves Moore's parity conjecture in the measured-output model.
titleEn: Regular trajectories, pruning and quantum parity
titleZh: 正则轨迹、剪枝与量子奇偶性

details.overview: 稿件研究常数深度量子线路计算奇偶性的能力。作者声称证明：使用任意单量子比特门与无界元Toffoli门、总量子比特数为多项式的常数深度量子线路，无法以任何固定正的最坏情形优势计算奇偶性；辅助比特初始化为 |0⟩，测量一个输出比特，其余末态寄存器可任意丢弃。摘要表示这在测量输出模型中解决Moore的奇偶性猜想。
